task: ADR-038 (Packaged Contextual Learning), re-approval after the 2026-10-30 open-question answers

criteria.description: Packages ContextualReinforceLearner for the already-exported ContextualSoftmaxPolicy, records the choose-time vector as metadata feature_vector, and adds task-policy-init --feature-dim and task-policy-decide --features for low authority only. No new LearningStore record type (ADR-002). The ADR-003 gate is unchanged. Design only. The 2026-10-30 answers do not change section 4 or section 7.

Four alternatives named and rejected: leave the learner in the example, teach ReinforceLearner both policy classes, package LinUCB or LinTS instead, and train on context_features. The 2026-10-30 answers do not add or remove an alternative.

States the exported training path and the costs: prior episodes have no training vector, features stay caller-defined, HYP-AL-004 stays open, and warm-start leaves weight rows at zero. Q2 confirms the zero-row start.

Names the unbuilt learner, the catalog remaining example_only, and missing real feature vectors. The caller names the coordinates of phi. A weight-row donor map waits for a later ADR. LinUCB/LinTS waits for a separate ADR under HYP-AL-018.

evidence.source: open_questions_answered_2026-10-30: caller names coordinates; donor map deferred; HYP-AL-018 stays a separate ADR; learner still unbuilt; catalog stays example_only
no fundamental flaw introduced by the open-question answers
answered deferrals are not a flaw
